category_title: Less-verbal students with HFA who struggle with contextual shifts and social pressure
scenario_title: Collaborative architectural design with multiple partners
minimal_context: The student is collaboratively designing an architecture in an OpenSim-based virtual environment with two partners simultaneously.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: K, for this fifth session, you need to collaboratively design the architecture with both C and A. Let's start adjusting the position and size of the items together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Types in text chat) I am putting a swimming pool on the balcony.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: C and A are asking to change the shape of the balcony and add their items next to yours. What should we tell them?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Types in text chat) Tell them to leave and wait downstairs for 5 minutes. I want private time with the pool.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: They are both trying to place their items in that area right now. You have to design with them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops typing in the text chat and becomes completely passive, appearing overwhelmed by C and A's simultaneous actions and failing to address their perspectives on the design.)
